title: How to Compare Yacht Catering Proposals in Dubai
body_html:
A yacht catering proposal needs an onboard plan as well as a menu. Compare galley space, marina loading, chilled storage, service hours and the captain’s requirements on the same brief.

For the service options, explore yacht catering in Dubai. Use this guide to prepare the details for your enquiry.

About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

Begin with the vessel and operator

Provide the yacht details, marina, boarding time and guest count. Ask the operator what cooking and bar arrangements are permitted. A compact galley may support finishing and service while requiring more preparation ashore.

Choose food that suits the service

Canapés, a buffet and a seated meal require different space and staffing. Check how food is carried aboard, held and replenished, and which items can be served comfortably as guests move around. Live stations require specific approval and facilities.

Compare the full onboard scope

Confirm chefs, waiters, equipment, loading, service duration and clear-down. The yacht charter, fuel and marina charges are separate from myCHEF catering. Published larger-charter examples are illustrative; a smaller guest count or different vessel needs its own written quote.

Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

Use your completed brief

If yacht catering suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.
